metrics.name: Product Testing Pass Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of products passing all testing criteria.

metrics.name: Time to Resolve Quality Issues
metrics.description: Average time it takes to address and fix reported quality issues.
metrics.formula: Total Resolution Time ÷ Number of Issues

metrics.name: Idea-to-Implementation Ratio
metrics.description: Percentage of ideas generated that are successfully implemented.

metrics.name: Percentage of Sustainable Products
metrics.description: Percentage of products designed with sustainable or eco-friendly materials.

metrics.name: R&D Spend as a Percentage of Revenue
metrics.description: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development activities.

metrics.name: Cost Per Feature Developed
metrics.description: Average cost incurred to develop a single feature.
metrics.formula: Total Development Costs ÷ Number of Features Developed

metrics.name: Team Utilization Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of team hours spent on productive development tasks.

metrics.name: Development Budget Adherence
metrics.description: Percentage of projects completed within the allocated budget.

metrics.name: Resource Allocation Efficiency
metrics.description: Percentage of resources effectively utilized across projects.

metrics.name: Cost Overrun Percentage
metrics.description: Percentage by which actual costs exceed the budgeted costs.

metrics.name: Feature-to-Product Cost Ratio
metrics.description: Average cost of features developed as a proportion of the total product cost.
metrics.formula: Total Feature Development Costs ÷ Total Product Development Costs

metrics.name: Development Rework Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of development work requiring rework or corrections.

metrics.name: Average Development Cost per Hour
metrics.description: Cost of development work per hour of team effort.
metrics.formula: Total Development Costs ÷ Total Hours Worked

metrics.name: Resource Turnover Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of team members replaced during the development process.

metrics.name: On-Time Completion Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of projects or tasks completed within the scheduled timeframe.

metrics.name: Milestone Achievement Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of project milestones achieved on or before the deadline.

metrics.name: Number of Overdue Tasks
metrics.description: Total number of tasks not completed by their assigned deadlines.

metrics.name: Scope Change Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of projects experiencing scope changes during execution.

metrics.name: Average Project Duration
metrics.description: Average time taken to complete a project from initiation to closure.
metrics.formula: Total Time for All Projects ÷ Number of Projects

metrics.name: Task Completion Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of tasks completed relative to the total tasks in a project.

metrics.name: Schedule Diff
metrics.description: Difference between the planned schedule and the actual schedule.

metrics.name: Planned vs. Actual Progress
metrics.description: Comparison of the planned progress percentage with the actual progress percentage at a specific time.

metrics.name: Project Success Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of projects delivered successfully, meeting scope, time, and budget.

metrics.name: Resource Utilization Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of resources effectively utilized during project delivery.

metrics.name: Budget Variance
metrics.description: Measures the difference between the planned budget and actual project expenses.

metrics.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
metrics.description: Indicates cost efficiency and financial performance.

metrics.name: Earned Value (EV)
metrics.description: Represents the value of work completed relative to the planned schedule and cost.

metrics.name: Actual Cost (AC)
metrics.description: Total actual costs incurred for the project so far.
metrics.formula: Sum of all Actual Project Costs

metrics.name: Estimate to Complete (ETC)
metrics.description: Estimate of the remaining cost required to complete the project.

metrics.name: To-Complete Performance Index (TCPI)
metrics.description: Forecasts the cost efficiency required to complete the project within the budget.

metrics.name: Cost Variance (CV)
metrics.description: Measures the difference between the earned value and actual costs.

metrics.name: Cost Overrun Percentage
metrics.description: Percentage by which actual costs exceed the original budget.

metrics.name: Cost per Deliverable
metrics.description: Average cost per deliverable or unit of work completed.

metrics.name: Budget Burn Rate
metrics.description: Rate at which project funds are being spent over time.

metrics.name: Average Task Duration
metrics.description: Average time taken to complete a task.
metrics.formula: Total Time Spent on Tasks ÷ Number of Tasks

metrics.name: Team Productivity Index
metrics.description: Composite measure of team output relative to effort and resources used.

metrics.name: Employee Engagement Score
metrics.description: Measures team engagement and satisfaction with the project.
metrics.formula: Derived from engagement surveys and feedback

metrics.name: Billable Utilization Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of team hours spent on billable project work.

metrics.name: Overtime Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of hours worked beyond standard working hours.

metrics.name: Collaboration Effectiveness Score
metrics.description: Measures the effectiveness of teamwork and collaboration.
metrics.formula: Survey metric based on team feedback

metrics.name: Absenteeism Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of scheduled work hours missed by team members.

metrics.name: Knowledge Sharing Index
metrics.description: Measures how effectively team members share knowledge and insights.
metrics.formula: Derived from survey results or observed activities
